axioms.name: execution_valid
axioms.statement: noncomputable axiom execution_valid (n : Nat) : BridgeCertificate (ntt_bridge n)
axioms.justification: Asserts that the NTT bridge from BabyBear proof space to execution space has a valid BridgeCertificate. This bridges Lean's formal layer to hardware execution — the point where mathematical proof meets physical computation. Cannot be proven within Lean without modeling the AVX-512 instruction set.
axioms.custody_path: no — enters the formal layer from outside
axioms.replacement_plan: Either (a) model AVX-512 semantics in Lean, or (b) provide runtime evidence (execution traces, hardware attestation) and treat as a verified assumption with external evidence.

axioms.name: babybear_ntt_end_to_end
axioms.statement: noncomputable axiom babybear_ntt_end_to_end (n : Nat) (v : BabyBearVec n) (h : (ntt_universe n).proof_kernel.admits_proof v) : (ntt_universe n).exec_kernel.admits_proof (ntt_map n v)
axioms.justification: Asserts that if a proof is admissible in the NTT universe's proof kernel, then the NTT-transformed proof is admissible in the execution kernel. This is the runtime correctness property for the Number Theoretic Transform pipeline. Requires hardware-level verification of the NTT implementation.
axioms.custody_path: no — enters the formal layer from outside
axioms.replacement_plan: Either (a) formally verify the NTT implementation in Lean, or (b) provide benchmark/test evidence and treat as a verified assumption with external evidence.
